verdict.rationale: Reader's own hosted proxy pool (x-proxy: auto) is documented to rotate residential and datacenter IPs and handle common anti-bot challenges automatically, which covers part of the CAPTCHA case. Login walls are only addressed by forwarding session cookies you supply via X-Set-Cookie, which is not automatic login, and form walls are not covered at all. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA-solving documentation, automated login or credential handling, form-wall submission, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the challenge bypass works.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.
Pass your session cookies with the `X-Set-Cookie` header and the Reader forwards them when fetching the URL
